title: Flow Play Zoom Styling
description: Fix flow play canvas styling breaking on zoom
summary: Fixed flow/procedural canvas reverting to hardcoded off-white Vello defaults after first interaction. Root cause: persistFixture updated parent fixtureJson prop which remounted the WASM session (fixtureJson was in FlowCanvas init effect deps); syncVelloTheme skipped re-apply when JSON string unchanged so new DagHost kept VelloThemePalette::default. Also rebuild_dag/reorganize/load_fixture_json replaced DagHost without preserving vello_theme. Fixes: bootstrap fixture ref only on mount (no session remount on persist), syncVelloTheme applies UI theme every frame, preserve vello_theme across rebuild_dag/reorganize/load_fixture_json, merge_from_json replaces from full UI payload not prior palette.
